purpose: Canonical execution-level, coverage, gap, result, and evidence registry for EmailAutomation release-safety scenarios.
authorizationBoundary: Gate 2 persistence, APIs, UI, credentials, deploys, and live-service work are not authorized by this registry.

L1.name: Pure local
L1.proves: Deterministic local behavior, validation, state transitions, safety rejection, and exact output contracts.
L1.doesNotProve: Emulator semantics, cloud permissions, provider behavior, deployment, or browser-to-worker operation.

L2.name: Local integration
L2.unavailableReason: No canonical disposable emulator suite is registered yet.
L2.proves: Local transactions, rules, serialization boundaries, retries, and read/write ownership.
L2.doesNotProve: External provider behavior, deployed identity, or operator-visible end-to-end behavior.

L3.name: Isolated service sandbox
L3.unavailableReason: No canonical dedicated-mailbox, Sheet, Firebase, and provider sandbox suite is registered yet.
L3.proves: Real provider semantics with dedicated identities and isolated test data.
L3.doesNotProve: Production data safety or the complete browser-to-worker product flow.

L4.name: Controlled end to end
L4.unavailableReason: No approved controlled-E2E campaign run is configured for this task.
L4.proves: Operator-visible cross-service behavior under explicit allowlist, monitoring, and rollback controls.
